stances.quote: I strongly believe funding for the military is imperative, and supporting our troops at home and abroad is fundamental.
stances.reasoning: Text explicitly endorses military funding as imperative.

stances.quote: We must put forth a budget which does not provide for tax breaks for the wealthy and big business on the backs of hard working American families and our most vulnerable communities.
stances.reasoning: Explicit opposition to tax breaks indicates preference against lower taxes.

stances.quote: I remain committed to responsibly reducing the deficit, but not at the cost of critical programs that support our most vulnerable communities.
stances.reasoning: Rejects cuts to programs while favoring investments, indicating preference for more spending.

stances.quote: Today, U.S. Representative Emanuel Cleaver, II (D-MO) urged the Trump Administration to reverse course on its plan to import 300,000 metric tons of foreign beef over the next 90 days.
stances.reasoning: Opposition to increased foreign beef imports signals protectionist stance.
